message:
Refine 1-time policy consent modal to match clean 2-tab pill and stacked action layout

- Removed the retention highlight chips and extra switch/note clutter from #ipon-policy-consent-dialog in js/policy.js.
- Styled the full-width 2-tab Terms of Use / Privacy Policy switcher, clean serif body headings, concise confirmation checkbox (I have read and agree to the myIPON Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.), and full-width stacked I agree & continue + Sign out buttons in css/app.css.
- Bumped css/app.css?v=20261116-118 and js/policy.js?v=20261116-02 across all HTML pages, synced mobile assets (npm run mobile:sync), and updated tests/contracts.test.mjs (141/141 passing).

Implement automated data retention, cloud media storage, annual archives, updated policies, and 1-time consent gate

- Database & Edge retention automation (Migrations 081–083):
  - Added nightly pg_cron job (`0 16 * * *` UTC / 12:00 AM PHT) for automated TTL cleanup: 7-day login throttles, 30-day call logs, read notifications, and unlinked recovery bin members, and 90-day chat messages, chat attachments, unread alerts, rejected/voided receipts, audit logs, and security activity logs (excluding removed `admin_requests` cleanup).
  - Added 6-month inactive account detection and automated purge queue with a 7-day prior warning email and `pending_storage_deletions` draining in `manage-account`, plus tuned `autovacuum` and Base64 scrubbing on `audit_logs`.
  - Added `ipon-media` bucket support and signed upload URLs (`media-upload-url`) so profile avatars, group DPs, QR codes, and receipts store bucket URLs instead of database Base64 blobs.
  - Enforced 500-character input caps on chat messages, transaction notes, and record discussion comments (keeping Group Announcements unlimited) across SQL and UI forms.
  - Added 1+ year financial annual roll-up (`financial_annual_archives`, `archive_group_year`) in Reports with a mandatory CSV-first export workflow.

- Updated Policies & Mandatory 1-Time Acceptance Gate:
  - Redesigned the Terms of Use & Privacy Policy dialogs with the dark obsidian-forest header, serif headings with warm-gold accent rules, horizontal-overflow fix, and complete day-by-day retention breakdown (`Last updated: November 16, 2026`).
  - Added `profiles.policy_accepted_version` / `policy_accepted_at`, `accept_current_policy` RPC, and noisy-key audit filtering (`write_audit_log`).
  - Extracted shared policy UI cleanly into `js/policy.js`, adding the mandatory 1-time-per-account Terms & Privacy consent modal (`I agree & continue`), in-app Terms/Privacy/Retention dialogs in Account Preferences, a 14-day periodic retention reminder, and a 90-day chat composer notice.
  - Fixed `js/auth.js` so `?policy=terms|privacy` stays open for already signed-in users until closed, synced mobile/web bundles (`npm run mobile:sync`), and verified `npm test` (141/141 passing).

Redesign voice recording pill, hide mobile header subtitles, preserve short chat previews, and harden Android background sync

- UI (Messages voice composer): Restyled the voice recording bar into a dark forest-emerald capsule with a pulsing coral indicator, tracked gold RECORDING label, tabular serif timer (`0:00`), outlined Cancel pill, warm gold two-line Send voice pill, and an active emerald mic circle beside equal circular Attach/Emoji buttons (`js/messages.js`, `css/app.css`). Added light/dark/midnight theme styling and responsive <=640px / <=380px sizing with zero horizontal overflow.
- UI (Mobile clutter cleanup): Hid static header, panel, account, modal, and Messages intro descriptions on mobile (`<=720px`) while keeping desktop copy and dynamic status/count elements intact (`css/app.css`).
- Database / Push previews: Applied migration `20261116_080_preserve_short_chat_notification_preview.sql` and updated `database/schema.sql` so 1+ character chat messages (e.g., `?`, `a`, `1`) and video attachments keep accurate notification previews instead of generic fallback copy.
- Android background reliability: Added concurrent wake queuing (`POLL_PENDING` with wake-lock handoff), explicit notification timestamps (`setWhen`/`setShowWhen`), and immediate WorkManager recovery sync (`enqueueImmediateSync`) in `NotificationPollReceiver.java`, `NotificationSyncService.java`, and `NotificationSyncWorker.java` so rapid or post-swipe alerts are not dropped.
- Build & Verification: Bumped `app.css` / `messages.js` cache-busters across HTML pages, synced Capacitor web assets (`npm run mobile:sync`), and added contract + VM tests (`tests/contracts.test.mjs` — 139/139 passing).

Fix non-FCM Android background notification delivery, WebSocket wakeups, and Supabase push dispatch

- Add migration `20261116_079_fix_background_push_dispatch.sql` (and sync `database/schema.sql`) so `notifications_push_dispatch` fires whenever unread deduplicated rows advance `created_at`.
- Harden `supabase/functions/send-push/index.ts` with JWT-safe `Authorization` handling, fallback Realtime broadcast via `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` and `httpSend('wake')`, and `native_has_token` / `native_ping_status` response telemetry.
- Add monochrome notification vector `android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_stat_myipon.xml` (replacing `@mipmap/ic_launcher` adaptive icon in `NotificationSyncService.java` and `NotificationPollReceiver.java`).
- Strengthen Android background sync in `NotificationSyncService.java`, `NotificationPollReceiver.java`, `BackgroundNotificationsPlugin.java`, and `AndroidManifest.xml` with `myipon:ws-wake` wake locks, network-switch reconnects, `scheduleServiceRestart` on task removal, `setExactAndAllowWhileIdle` support (`SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` maxSdkVersion 32), JWT-safe REST polling, and socket/poll diagnostic status fields.
- Force background polling configuration in `js/core.js` when permissions or preferences enable, auto-resync on disconnected socket/missing config, update test alert feedback, bump `core.js?v=20261116-94` and Capacitor metadata, and add contract tests in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.

Fix full-width voice waveforms, background prompt buttons, and instant sent voice playback

- Stretch chat voice-note waveforms cleanly across the full player width (`VOICE_WAVE_HEIGHTS` 36 bars + `justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5px` on `.msg-voice-wave` in `css/app.css` and `js/messages.js`) to eliminate the trailing right gap on mobile and desktop.
- Prevent mobile vertical stretching on `#background-usage-prompt-dialog` buttons (`.bg-usage-actions .button` resets `flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 44px;`) and add high-contrast `.is-busy` spinner feedback (`Allowing…` / `Checking…`, `.button.is-busy:disabled { opacity: .92; cursor: wait; }`) in `js/core.js` and `css/app.css`.
- Generate local `blob:` preview URLs immediately for recorded voice messages and picked audio files so newly sent voice notes render and play without waiting on `chat-view-urls`.
- Track signed-URL readiness in `computeThreadFingerprint`, bypass in-place thread patching while `.msg-att-loading` placeholders exist, and add bounded retry recovery via `scheduleMissingSignedUrls` in `js/messages.js`.
- Bump `app.css`, `core.js`, and `messages.js` cache-busters across all HTML pages, sync Capacitor mobile assets (`js/version.js`, `version.json`), and add contract/VM test coverage in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.

Mic App

Test if okay na

Fix chat drawer overlap, inline peer status, presence dot sizing, native VM mic prompt, and dashboard offline UI

- Enlarge .presence-dot across avatar tiers with theme-matched header borders in css/app.css.
- Restructure #msg-thread-active and .msg-thread-drawer in js/messages.js and css/app.css so Chat Info & Options spans full pane height on desktop and overlays above the pinned banner on tablet/mobile.
- Move the active/typing status line next to the Friend badge inside .msg-thread-peer-sub without wrapping or horizontal overflow.
- Keep launch startup limited to notifications in MainActivity.java, trigger Android's system Microphone permission dialog on demand when recording voice messages via BackgroundNotificationsPlugin.java, detect outdated APK binaries lacking RECORD_AUDIO in js/messages.js, and redirect to App Settings only after permanent denial.
- Remove the stale-snapshot warning banner from js/dashboard.js on refresh errors when data is already loaded, and verify logo-free offline fallback assets via npm run mobile:sync.
- Bump CSS/JS cache-busters across HTML pages and expand runtime/contract coverage in tests/contracts.test.mjs.

Remove automatic push update notifications and APK download buttons

- Stop synthesizing persistent `system-app-release-notice` alerts on mobile in `initNotifications()` (`js/core.js`) so release notifications only appear when explicitly announced via database records and mark read cleanly.
- Remove `Download APK` buttons, action links, and download-prompt copy from notification items, `openNoticeDetailModal()`, and the release announcement viewer banner.
- Bump `js/core.js?v=20261115-91` across all 16 HTML pages, sync Capacitor bundle metadata (`version.json` / `js/version.js` 1.0.20 build 20), and add runtime contract coverage in `tests/contracts.test.mjs` (133/133 passing).

Redesign Chat Info drawer, Messaging & Privacy modal, and full-column chat themes

- Chat Info & Options drawer (js/messages.js, css/app.css):
  - Rebuild the drawer header with a circular close button, centered gold-ringed hero avatar without presence overlap, 2-column outline-icon chat action cards, 5 circular theme swatches with check indicators, and Shared media / Shared files navigation cards with count pills.
  - Preserve Shared media and Shared files drill-down views and Back navigation.
- Messaging & Privacy modal (js/messages.js, css/app.css):
  - Apply a responsive 2-column top form layout with non-shifting username validation, live `0 / 240 characters` bio counter, 3 soft-mint toggle cards, busy-safe Save button styling, and a separated Blocked accounts footer with count badge and empty shield state.
  - Guard `dialog.showModal()` calls against re-opening an already open dialog.
- Full-column chat themes (js/messages.js, css/app.css):
  - Sync `data-chat-theme` (Paper, Emerald, Sage, Sand, Midnight) across both `#msg-thread-pane` and `#msg-thread-stage` via `--thread-*` CSS variables so the top header, search bar, pinned banner/pill/panel, stage, and bottom composer update together in Light and Dark modes, with optimistic UI updates and reset when closing or clearing a thread.
- Verification & build sync:
  - Bump CSS and `js/messages.js` cache-buster parameters across the 16 HTML pages, sync Capacitor metadata (`version.json` / `js/version.js` 1.0.20 build 20), and pass all 132 contract checks in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.

Fix messaging back stack, Sent/Delivered/Seen receipts, video viewer, and reaction flicker

- Handle Android hardware Back step by step through window.Ipon.handleNativeBack() and IponMessages.handleBackNavigation() (menus -> viewers/modals -> info drawer -> thread search -> chat list -> inbox tab -> dashboard -> exit) before falling back to native exit.
- Separate outgoing message receipt states cleanly: 1 gray check for Sent, 2 gray checks for Delivered, and 2 green checks for Seen, and guard isThreadActivelyVisible() with document.hasFocus(), window focus/blur listeners, MainActivity.onWindowFocusChanged(), <= 820px compact-pane checks, and overlay/drawer occlusion checks so incoming notifications never prematurely trigger mark_conversation_read.
- Add SVG preview posters with probed aspect-ratio locking for inline chat and Shared Media videos, suppress native <video controls>, and route fullscreen playback through the custom #ipon-video-viewer dock (Ipon.openVideoViewer) with download support.
- Patch message reactions and receipt ticks in place (patchMessageReactionsDom, patchMessageReceiptsDom, tryPatchActiveThreadInPlace) with overflow-anchor: auto so reacting on video messages never resets thread DOM or flickers.
- Sync mobile assets (npm run mobile:sync), bump HTML cache-busters (css/app.css, js/core.js, js/messages.js), and verify all 131 tests in tests/contracts.test.mjs pass.

Add mobile background usage controls, voice mic access, pinch-zoom viewer, and offline fixes

- Add background usage & device alert controls inside My account (modal and account.html) with live status pills, settings fallbacks, and an automatic onboarding prompt for new APK users so closed-app messages and alerts keep arriving.
- Harden native Android background sync on resume and battery-optimization request fallbacks across MainActivity and BackgroundNotificationsPlugin.
- Request microphone permissions on first install and voice-message tap across Android, iOS, and WebView with clean settings recovery guidance.
- Upgrade the chat image viewer to edge-to-edge pinch-to-zoom and pan with working native DownloadManager/MediaStore and blob downloads.
- Default the mobile Messages launcher to Chats, close open thread overlays when switching to Requests, map offline/fetch errors to user-friendly messages, and remove the broken offline logo image.
- Sync mobile assets, bump HTML asset cache-busters, and expand automated checks in tests/contracts.test.mjs.

Polish messaging reactions, pinned messages, media viewer, and profile cards

- Replace dark pinned banner and per-row unpin buttons with a light-green expandable pill, numbered pin list, and single active-message highlight (`renderPinnedBanner`, `syncActivePinnedHighlight`).
- Switch reactions to press-and-hold across text bubbles, photos, and videos with smooth open/close transitions (`HOLD_EXCLUDE_SEL`, `revealFloatingMenu`) and remove redundant Reply/Copy action buttons from the emoji strip.
- Keep message bubbles and 3-dots actions tightly aligned via `.msg-bubble-wrap`, restore `Reply` inside the 3-dots menu (`startReplyToMessage`), clean up reply quotes, and switch the unread separator badge to green.
- Update the Chat Info drawer to drill into separate scrollable `Shared media` and `Shared files` views (`threadInfoView`), redesign `#msg-profile-popover` with an expandable shared-groups card (`renderSharedGroupsCard`), and fix reopening the same chat after Back on mobile.
- Restyle the shared image viewer in `js/core.js` (`openImageViewer`), bump HTML asset cache-busters and mobile build metadata (`version.json`, `js/version.js`, `js/release-commits.json`), and update contract tests in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.
Add messaging workspace, signal-only audit filters, and polished chat UI
Style My Account modal with warm cards, serif typography, and emerald header
Refresh release commits feed
Restore member group savings summary and read-only transparency RLS

Lock desktop calendar row heights and contain scrollable announcements

- Fix desktop calendar cards and rows stretching vertically by setting flex: 0 0 auto on .calendar-card/.calendar-board and fixed 90px row height on .calendar-week while keeping compact mobile heights.
- Isolate desktop 3-column grid row sizing using contain: size on .review-column so the right rail aligns cleanly with the calendar bottom without inflating calendar height.
- Ensure .announcement-panel .announcement-list scrolls smoothly with thin themed scrollbars and flex: 0 0 auto on announcement items so cards never squish or dump unclipped down the page.
- Bump asset cache tags (?v=20261115-83), sync Capacitor assets, and add contract tests.

Enforce member login activation gate and fix member count & delete integrity

- Gate official active membership on account sign-in via members.activation_status (PENDING | ACTIVE) and ctivate_own_pending_account RPC sync on login/session init.
- Fix members_select RLS policy and query filters to exclude soft-deleted members (deleted_at IS NULL) across Dashboard, Member directory, Records, Reports, Savings, and Settings.
- Drop remaining stale overloaded RPC signatures in migration 072 and clean empty orphan contribution periods for non-official members.
- Update manage-account Edge Function to keep invited members pending until actual sign-in, and refine Member directory status/delete UX.

Fix create_announcement RPC overload conflict (PGRST203) and clean up stale signatures

- Add migration 20261115_070_drop_overloaded_rpc_signatures.sql to drop the 7 stale shorter overloaded RPC signatures left over in production (including 4-arg public.create_announcement) and reload PostgREST schema cache.

- Fix database/schema.sql grants for 6-arg public.create_announcement(uuid, text, text, jsonb, text, text) and sync migration 070 drops and ledger entry.

- Pass explicit p_announcement_type: 'GENERAL' and p_release_version: null in js/core.js when publishing announcements.

- Bump core.js HTML cache-buster tags (?v=20261115-81), sync Capacitor/www assets, refresh js/release-commits.json, and add contract tests (122/122 passing).

Route notification deep links, refine audit log details, and remove obsolete Super Admin requests

- Route release/announcement updates, reviews, reminders, invites, feature requests, and bug report notifications directly to their exact modals or highlighted records across SQL (migration 069), push/account Edge functions, Service Worker (sw.js), Android MainActivity, and role panels.
- Replace raw Audit Log column/JSON/base64 dumps with plain-language summaries and inline photo previews, limiting Before -> After cards to actual changed field values while displaying action reasons and attributions (e.g. Removal reason, Removed by, Void reason, Review note) as single clean detail cards.
- Remove the obsolete Administrator Requests navigation tab, overview metric/shortcut, table section, approval/rejection dialogs, and handlers from the Super Admin panel, and update the platform metrics grid and synced ./www, Android, and iOS assets.
- Remove the trailing arrow from the login/create-account submit button in login.html, sync cache-busted HTML asset tags (?v=20261115-80), and update contract tests (121/121 passing).

Eliminate Android white startup flash, add progressive login brute-force lockout, and polish account profile UI

- Fix Android 12+ cold-start splash blank white screen with #0b3428 windowSplashScreenBackground, dark system bars, and MainActivity window background matching the pulsing emerald splash
- Implement progressive anti-brute-force login protection across migration 068, schema.sql, manage-account Edge Function, login.html, and js/auth.js
- Remove Phone & drawer alerts preference card from account.html and js/core.js
- Style .account-profile-identity small as plain muted text instead of a pill badge in light and dark themes
- Bump HTML cache versions, sync js/release-commits.json, and expand tests/contracts.test.mjs

Smooth emerald splash intro, disable auto update popup, and preserve nav shell state during loading

- Eliminate Android cold-start white screen with #0b3428 splash theme, layout/WebView background, and Capacitor backgroundColor

- Replace login splash img with inline SVG myIPON emblem and smooth scale pulse animation while keeping splash active during signed-in redirect

- Stop automatic app update modal popups on startup and visibility change unless explicitly forced

- Pre-apply theme/role in head via config.js + hero-plates.css and persist role nav tabs, unread notification badge count, user DP, and name across loading transitions

- Add contract and VM runtime tests covering splash, disabled auto update popup, and zero-flicker shell state; bump asset cache versions to 20261115-75

Refine dashboard and landing UI, add social/Gmail contact links, payout mobile validation, and flexible Super Admin names

- Allow only `SUPER_ADMIN` accounts to save non-formal/lowercase names and optional last names in `js/core.js`, `js/account.js`, `database/migrations/20261115_067_super_admin_flexible_name.sql`, and `database/schema.sql`, while keeping strict formal capitalization rules for all other roles.
- Enforce live PH mobile validation (`09XXXXXXXXX` / `+639XXXXXXXXX`) on GCash and Maya payout inputs in `js/core.js` alongside backend validation in `database/migrations/20261115_066_payout_mobile_validation.sql`.
- Refine the dashboard hero, group bar, and member status layouts (`dashboard.html`, `user.html`, `css/hero-plates.css`, `css/app.css`, `js/dashboard.js`, `js/user.js`) to embed the group switcher inside the group identity card, size wallet cards cleanly, and remove excess mobile spacing.
- Update the landing page (`index.html`, `css/landing.css`, `js/index.js`, `login.html`) with `E-wallet · Bank · Cash` highlights, direct Gmail compose links (`zedrickdemonteverde1@gmail.com`), footer social links with icons (Facebook, X, Instagram, Discord), and stable non-shifting hover icons.
- Bump asset cache-bust versions across HTML pages and expand contract coverage in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.

Upgrade server-side AI release notes, server Gemini key setup, landing showcase, and dark-mode contrast

- Replace client/procedural release-note fallbacks with authentic server-side Gemini AI generation in `supabase/functions/manage-account/index.ts`, categorizing changes into non-empty New Features, Fixes, Improvements, Features Requested by Users, Security Updates, and Other Changes.
- Add `coerceReleaseBulletText` and `coerceReleaseBulletList` across the Edge Function and `js/super-admin.js` (plus `[object Object]` sanitization) so nested AI JSON objects always render as detailed readable bullets.
- Add Super-Admin-only `gemini-key-status`, `save-gemini-key`, and `test-gemini-key` actions backed by `public.internal_webhook_config`, update endpoint routing to prioritize `generativelanguage.googleapis.com` for free-tier `AQ.`/`AIza...` keys, fail fast on `401`/`403`/`BILLING_DISABLED`, and wire inline **Configure API key** recovery in `super-admin.html`, `js/super-admin.js`, and `js/core.js`.
- Auto-generate `js/release-commits.json` during `scripts/supabase-migrate.mjs` sync and add explicit change detection plus empty-state dialog handling when no new updates have landed.
- Fix `.toast` and `.inline-error` text wrapping plus dark-mode arrow/contrast styling in `css/app.css`, update the interactive showcase/theme preview in `index.html`, `css/landing.css`, and `js/index.js`, align policy modal deep-linking in `login.html` and `js/auth.js`, and expand contract verification in `tests/contracts.test.mjs`.

Add settings theme switcher, payment channel icons, live announcement names, and AI release notes polish

- Add Light/Dark mode switcher inside Settings with readable contrast across dashboards, hero plates, and landing views
- Upgrade payout and payment dropdowns with GCash, Maya, Bank, and Cash icons and refine per-field formal name validation
- Keep announcement author display names synchronized live when users update their profile name
- Upgrade Write with AI release notes to rewrite fresh, user-focused updates and filter out internal developer details
- Remove square avatar container borders, enforce circular close/remove button geometry, and fix startup initialization stability

Add money input validation, zero-layout-shift wallet table, mobile-only drawer alerts, and workspace UI/UX skills

Money and wallet reconciliation inputs now validate numeric format, decimals, and maximum limits up to 999,999,999,999.99 via shared helpers in js/core.js (parseMoneyAmount, validateMoneyInput, and guardMoneyInput), preventing floating-point precision overflow and adding missing max attributes on record edit and savings calculator amount fields.

Wallet reconciliation in reports now locks desktop column widths with fixed table layout, top-aligned cells, tabular numerals, bounded variance pills, and a non-collapsing error slot in css/app.css and js/reports.js so textboxes never shift horizontally or vertically while typing or displaying inline errors.

Device and drawer notification prompts, banners, and tray dispatches in account.html and js/core.js are now scoped strictly to mobile clients so desktop PC users no longer see Phone & drawer alerts or Turn on prompts while mobile push and permission sync remain active.

Workspace AI UI/UX standards and design intelligence are added under AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/stable-input-ui, and the UI/UX Pro Max v2.5.0 skill suite under .agents/skills, with updated contract coverage in tests/contracts.test.mjs passing 104/104 on npm test.

Add background push notifications, formal name validation, discussion media attachments, and UI refinements

Record discussions now support lossless file, photo, and video attachments via signed upload and view URLs (migration 061), track read state so unread count badges clear once opened (migration 062), fire replaceable comment notifications (migration 060), and always expose the Discuss button on contribution records including confirmed and void entries.
Closed-app notifications are enabled through VAPID Web Push delivery with the send-push Edge Function and push subscriptions schema (migration 063, sw.js), alongside native Android background sync via NotificationSyncService, NotificationSyncWorker, BackgroundNotificationsPlugin, and NotificationPollReceiver. Permission handling now checks both OS and browser states live, provides Android settings shortcuts and unblock instructions with recheck support, and uses clear On, Turn on, and Blocked labels.
Account and form workflows now enforce formal name capitalization with live validation across signup, account, member, treasurer, and administrator forms, and require optional-name link invites to complete their name immediately after sign-in (migration 064, manage-account). Additional UI refinements hide the excess carry-over toggle unless entered payments exceed the monthly due, restrict the ADMIN badge to group contexts, align the sidebar Sign out button, and remove the redundant green progress bar under Collected this month. All updates are covered by tests/contracts.test.mjs with 103/103 passing on npm test.
